title: Fabula Ultima Sprite Animator
description: 2D skeletal animation for character sprites. Rig any PNG or WebP sprite in the Sprite Animation Studio (bones, joints, bending parts, hidden-region fill), use 37 reusable animations (idles, movement, attacks, spells, defence, reactions) or make your own, and let actors' tokens play them on the map: attacks, spells and skills from Project FU chat cards trigger the matching animation, targets react, defeated characters fall. Pixel art stays pixel-exact. Works alongside Fabula Ultima Battle Animations.

recommends.reason: Battle effects, dashes and impacts; the sprite animator animates the characters themselves.
